name: Pane
text: Pane: A live HTML/CSS prototype locks us into early technical debt—if the data feeds change or the API shifts, we’ll waste cycles rebuilding the frontend instead of refining the UX. A hybrid approach: build a minimal, *modular* HTML/CSS shell in Figma first, then layer in live data only where it matters most, like the core visualization. That way we test real constraints without overcommitting to fragile code. Settle it by prototyping just the data-heavy component in HTML/CSS while keeping the rest in Figma—if it slows us down, we pivot.
